1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.ClosedCutSet
2 
3 /-! The same cut set viewed in ambient three-space, for intersections
4 with genuine original-face segments. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
7 
8 open Set
9 
10 /-- The previously defined cut set, with the boundary subtype forgotten. -/
11 def cutSetInSpace (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) : Set Space :=
12   Subtype.val '' P.cutSet a
13 
14 theorem mem_cutSetInSpace (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : frontier P.body) :
15     (b : Space) ∈ P.cutSetInSpace a ↔ b ∈ P.cutSet a := by
16   constructor
17   · rintro ⟨c, hc, same⟩
18     exact (Subtype.ext same : c = b) ▸ hc
19   · exact fun member => ⟨b, member, rfl⟩
20 
21 theorem cutSetInSpace_subset_boundary (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) :
22     P.cutSetInSpace a ⊆ frontier P.body := by
23   rintro _ ⟨b, _, rfl⟩
24   exact b.property
25 
26 namespace SixVertexGraph
27 
28 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
29   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
30     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
31 
32 include graph small_faces in
33 theorem cutSetInSpace_compact (a : frontier P.body) : IsCompact (P.cutSetInSpace a) :=
34   (graph.cutSet_compact small_faces a).image continuous_subtype_val
35 
36 end SixVertexGraph
37 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
